thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy window preflight: change window 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Canary recipe: 3% -> 10% -> 30% over 15m. Observability snapshot: https://console.redwood/infradash/snap/def456. Gates: p99 < 350ms, error_rate < 0.4%. Running automated smoke checks now.

morgan: Quick heads-up — p99 for seq-gen on us-central canary is at ~420ms (baseline 290). Not sure if it's noise.

diego: I see a short blip of 503s from cache-layer (cdn-cache) during the same minute. 503s ~0.6% at +4m.

anya: Can we get a flamegraph or tail the cache logs? `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=cdn-cache --since=15m | tail -n 200`

morgan: Doing that now. Also checking downstream retries spikes in the trace view.

release-coordinator: Reminder: policy is auto-pause on p99 > gate or error_rate > 0.5% for 3m. Manual hold allowed if lead requests.

diego: Logs show a rapid sequence of cache invalidation entries: `invalidate key=*model:v2*` — looks like a stray job triggered invalidation. That would cause KV misses and p99 inflation.

anya: If it's an invalidation storm, warming may take time. Suggest pause ramp and run quick warm + rate-limit invalidations.

tonEr: (typo) sorry ignore

ton y: I'll rate-limit the invalidation job via the scheduled job's concurrency knob. `kubectl -n infra patch cronjob cache-invalidate -p '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid"}}'`

morgan: After rate-limit, p99 dropped to 330ms in the latest minute, error_rate 0.42% (10m window). Still above p99 gate but improving.

deploy-bot: Auto-pause condition not yet met. Current rule: `canary:p99 > 350ms for 3m` would pause. We're at 2m over threshold.

diego: We should consider pin fallback ready. Pin target: `seq-gen:2026-03-19-stable`. I can prepare the pin command.

anya: Also we should add a temporary cache-prewarm on the canary and reduce concurrency on the service to avoid thundering herd. `curl -X POST https://ops-api/warm?svc=seq-gen&percent=3`

morgan: I've kicked the warm script. CPU on one canary pod spiked (python worker) but autoscaler caught a second replica.

release-coordinator: Action items: diego -> confirm invalidation job change; anya -> run warm and monitor p99; morgan -> keep eye on traces and 5xxs; tony -> stand by for pin execute if hold is requested.

ton y: Pin command staged: `deployctl pin --service seq-gen --version seq-gen:2026-03-19-stable --reason "cache invalidation storm"`

morgan: Triage snapshot link: https://console.redwood/infradash/snap/def456?trace=t-2201. Noting that most 503s are concentrated on one host (host-12).

diego: host-12 had a disk pressure OOM event earlier today, marked as degraded. Kube didn't evict due to lower priority. That explains the concentrated errors. I'll cordon host-12 and drain non-critical pods.

release-coordinator: Good call. Cordon/drain reduces risk of recurring 503s. We still prefer not to rollback if we can remediate quickly.

deploy-bot: Update: at +8m p99=305ms, error_rate=0.25% (10m window). The canary ramp remains paused by manual gate.

anya: Looks safe to resume ramp if p99 stays < 320ms for 5m and no 5xx bursts. Propose resume steps: 3% -> 7% -> 15% -> 30% with 3m observation between steps.

ton y: Acknowledged. I'll hold the pin unless we see regression.

morgan: One more note for release notes: add a bullet about temporary invalidation fix and recommend customers to expect minimal transient latency. I'll update the changelog in confluence: https://confluence.redwood/releases/2026-03-22-seq-gen#notes

diego: Draining host-12 now. `kubectl drain host-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

release-coordinator: We're good to proceed with staged ramp after 5m observation. If anything spikes back, we'll execute the staged pin using the prepared command.

deploy-bot: Final: snapshot will be posted at +15m or on decision. To execute pin reply `@deploy-bot execute pin` (requires two approvals: release-lead + oncall).

morgan: Thanks team, monitoring.

anya: Running the 5m watch now.

ton y: Standing by for approval.
